experiment: E012 — Combine Game Equivalents (CGE): how many NFL games of a player's own tracking is his Combine worth, trait by trait, and how to blend the two in season
written_by: orchestrator, before any CGE, variance component or in-season forecast in this design was computed
already_seen_before_this_prereg: E001-E010 player-level links (transfer map): position-drill signatures show no detectable link beyond B2; WR tracked top speed is the only (fragile) signal.

Writeup v1 post hoc (experiments/posthoc_writeup_v1/ph_inseason.json): for WR game top speed, one game of a player's own tracking forecasts his later game top speed about as well as his best Combine measure (r 0.56 vs 0.57, n = 42). This motivated E012; that analysis is NOT counted as evidence here.
Split-half reliabilities of most game traits (E002-E010 logs).

framework.model: For trait T at position P: game-level value y_ig = theta_i + e_ig, between-player variance tau2 (within position, after draft-year centering), between-game within-player variance sigma2. lambda = sigma2 / tau2 (games of noise per unit of signal). An information set C forecasts theta out of sample with R2_C (true-score R2 = cross-validated R2 on the player-level trait divided by that trait's reliability, clipped to [0, 0.99]).
framework.estimand: CGE_C = lambda * R2_C / (1 - R2_C): the number of games of the player's own data that forecast theta as well as C does. Equivalently, C is a prior worth CGE_C pseudo-games on top of shrinkage to the position mean.
framework.in_season_rule: After k games with mean ybar_k: theta_hat = mu_C + w_k (ybar_k - mu_C), w_k = k / (k + lambda (1 - R2_C)), where mu_C is C's forecast.
framework.tracking_value: Delta CGE = CGE(C3) - CGE(C2): games of in-season data that the Combine tracking adds beyond the stopwatch and draft slot.

information_sets.C3: C2 + Combine tracking: tracked-40 set (bdb27.speed c40_smax, c40_v_20_40, c40_vmax, c40_tau, c40_a0) plus the trait's matched drill signature listed below (if any)
information_sets.model: median-impute + indicators -> standardize -> RidgeCV (linkage._model), repeated 5-fold CV (20 repeats), player-level

traits.game_value: per-game q90 of play max speed (plays > 12 yd/s dropped; games with >= 10 tracked plays)
per-game mean of route-centered OUT/IN turn retention (E002 definitions, probes.a_route_breaks; games with >= 2 events)
per-game mean of HITCH peak braking (E002; games with >= 2 events)
per-game mean of separation over expected on HITCH/OUT/IN routes (E002 soe definition; games with >= 3 routes)
per-game mean of yards per route over expected (E007 yprr_oe residuals; games with >= 10 routes)
per-game mean of first-second rush distance (E003 g_d10_rush play values; games with >= 5 pass-rush snaps)
per-game mean of player_get_off on pass-rush snaps (games with >= 5)
per-game pressure rate over expected (E003 definitions; games with >= 10 pass-rush snaps)
per-game mean of pass-set acceleration 0-0.6 s (E004 set_accel play values; games with >= 10 qualifying sets)
per-game pressure allowed over expected (E004 pr_oe definitions; games with >= 15 pass-block snaps)
per-game mean of pre-throw peak retreat speed (E005 gm_backpedal play values; games with >= 3 plays)
per-game q90 of play max speed (as T1)

estimation.variance_components: One-way random effects of game-level values within position after draft-year centering (bdb27.reliability.icc1 machinery: tau2 = between, sigma2 = within), players with >= 3 qualifying games.
estimation.uncertainty: Player bootstrap (1,000 resamples) of the whole pipeline (lambda, R2_C, CGE) per trait.
estimation.exposure_checks: corr(player trait, log games) and corr(per-game value, plays in game), reported per trait.

validation_1_internal: For players with >= 8 qualifying games: chronologically first k games (k = 1..6) vs Combine forecasts (C0-C3, out of fold), each correlated with the player's mean over his remaining games. Empirical crossover k = first k where the k-game correlation reaches C's. Report agreement with formula CGE (does the formula CGE fall inside the bootstrap CI of the empirical crossover?).

validation_2_prospective.design: Fit tau2, sigma2, R2_C and the ridge models on the 2023 + 2024 classes ONLY. Apply them to 2025 rookies (their one season): for each 2025 player with >= k + 3 qualifying games, forecast his mean over games k+1..end with (a) Combine only (mu_C), (b) games only (ybar_k), (c) the in-season rule (blend), for k = 1, 2, 3, 4.
validation_2_prospective.metric: Squared error of each forecast, standardized by the trait's 2023-24 tau2, averaged over the trait's eligible 2025 players; pooled over traits with equal trait weights.

primary_tests.claim: Blend (C2 prior) beats games-only at k = 1 (pooled standardized MSE lower).
Blend (C2 prior) beats games-only at k = 2.
Combine tracking improves the prior: blend with C3 prior beats blend with C2 prior at k = 1.

validation_2_prospective.inference: Player-level paired differences in standardized squared error (trait-weighted), one-sided sign-flip permutation test (100,000 flips) and a player bootstrap 95% CI; BH across H1-H3; alpha 0.05.
validation_2_prospective.secondary: Same comparisons per trait and for k = 3, 4 (descriptive); calibration of the rule's implied uncertainty (coverage of 80% intervals).

deliverables: CGE table and figure: traits x information sets, games with 95% bootstrap CI, plus Delta CGE for tracking
in-season weight curves w_k by trait

2025 rookie case studies: Combine prior vs first-k-game estimates vs rest of season (chosen by a rule fixed here: the 2 largest and 2 smallest |prior - final| per position among players with >= 10 games)
a 'Combine surprises' table (descriptive): 2025 rookies whose season trait differs most from their C2 prior, in prior-SD units
go: H1-H3 judged by the BH-adjusted one-sided tests. The CGE estimates are descriptive estimands with CIs, not hypothesis tests.
